key: Heh, our luck's sour lately, huh?
en: Heh, our luck's sour lately, huh?
ja: へっ、最近ツイてないよな?

key: I suppose you're the one responsible for that.
en: I suppose you're the one responsible for that.
ja: コールマン: それって、お前のせいなんだろうな。

key: The bosses even lost control of the PULSE here. Oops.
en: The bosses even lost control of the PULSE here. Oops.
ja: ボスたちは、ここのPULSEの制御まで失っちまってな。あちゃー。

key: We were originally developing new technology here, but it kindaaaa went bad. You won't get to see it though!
en: We were originally developing new technology here, but it kindaaaa went bad. You won't get to see it though!
ja: ここでは元々新技術を開発してたんだけど、ちょーっとまずいことになっちまってさ。まあ、お前には見せてやらないけどな!
メアリー: ま、見せちゃうかもね。

key: The power from this PULSE project would have been really useful, but it backfired and caused a bunch of problems everywhere.
en: The power from this PULSE project would have been really useful, but it backfired and caused a bunch of problems everywhere.
ja: このPULSE計画の力は、本当に役立つはずだったのに、逆効果になって、あちこちで色々問題を起こしちまった。

key: First all these earthquakes underneath the base. Now you again!
en: First all these earthquakes underneath the base. Now you again!
ja: まずは基地の下でのこの地震続き。今度はまたお前かよ!
グレッチェン: グルルルル!

key: This place is just full of problems!
en: This place is just full of problems!
ja: ここは問題だらけだよ!

key: Hey. Pokémon out. This time, I'm taking you down.
en: Hey. Pokémon out. This time, I'm taking you down.
ja: おい。ポケモンを出せ。今度こそ、お前をぶちのめしてやる。

key: Stop trying to make this happen. It's not going to happen!
en: Stop trying to make this happen. It's not going to happen!
ja: レジーナ: そうなろうとするのはやめな。そうはならないんだから!
もう、あたしから離れてよ!
